1 Similes indices cognominum signorum zodiaci invenies apud Ludwich,
Maximi et Ammonis rel., p. 105 et in nostro Catal. Flor., p. 164 s.
2 Haec paene ad verbum consentiunt cum excerpto quod, Teucro Babylonio
auctore supposito, ex codice Monacensi 287 edidit Franciscus Boll, Catal. Flor.,
p. 150, v. 5 ss. Quod excerptum re vera non Teucro tribuendum esse, sed Helio-
doro et ex libro nostro Neapolitano apparet et Boll ipse collato codice Oxoniensi
posterius animadvertit (Sphaera, p. 32, n. 1). — De Heliodoro astronomo, cf. supra,
p. 81, n. 1, et de duobus Heliodori libellis, cuius reliquiae supersunt, vide quae in
Catal., VI, Kroll ad cod. Vindobon. phil. gr. 179 [= 3] f. 65 adnotavit. [F. C.]
sections.en: 1 Similar lists of the surnames of the signs of the zodiac you will find in Ludwich, Maximi et Ammonis rel., p. 105 and in our Catal. Flor., p. 164 f. 2 These agree almost word for word with the excerpt which, with Teucer of Babylon supposed as the author, Franz Boll edited from the Munich codex 287, Catal. Flor., p. 150, v. 5 ff. That this excerpt in truth must not be attributed to Teucer, but to Heliodorus is apparent both from our Neapolitan book and Boll himself, having collated the Oxford codex, later noticed (Sphaera, p. 32, n. 1). — Concerning Heliodorus the astronomer, cf. above, p. 81, n. 1, and concerning the two little books of Heliodorus, whose remains survive, see what in Catal., VI, Kroll noted on cod. Vindobon. phil. gr. 179 [= 3] f. 65. [F. C.]

summary.headline: Zodiac Sign Qualities and Decans
summary.text: A classification of zodiac signs by public, good, just, licentious, destructive, deceitful, manic, elemental, diurnal, nocturnal, and other qualities, alongside planetary benefic and malefic attributions. The page then begins Heliodorus’s astronomical teaching on the three decans of each zodiac sign and their ten-degree divisions.
